New message in #sales:

dave: @lobu who owns the Globex account these days?

input.text: @dave I don't have a way to look up account ownership from here. If you've got the CRM connector set up (or want to add one), I can pull that info directly. Otherwise, best bet is checking the account record in [your CRM] or asking in #sales channel for a quick answer. Want me to help set up a CRM lookup?

content.text: Responded to Dave. I don't have any CRM/account-lookup tools available, so I flagged that and offered to help set up a connector if they'd like that capability.
